contract_ref: Startup contract requires deterministic path resolution — validator path resolution must be coupled to workspace boundary, not validator location

derivation_chain.step: Validator looks for .librarian/project-index.json relative to its own location (LIBRARIAN_ROOT), not workspace root
Workspace-level project-index.json exists at WORKSPACE_ROOT/.librarian/project-index.json but validator cannot find it

finding.title: Selector routing path bug — validator path resolution coupled to validator location
finding.description: validate-startup-selector-routing.py computes PROJECT_INDEX relative to its own file location (SessionStartup/../../.librarian/project-index.json) rather than resolving from the workspace boundary. The workspace-level project-index.json exists at the correct location but the validator cannot find it.
finding.invariant_violated: Validators must resolve paths from workspace boundary, not from validator file location
finding.impact: Selector routing validation cannot verify explicit project selection; the validator fails on a path resolution bug, not a substantive defect

recommendation.description: Fix path resolution in validate-startup-selector-routing.py to use workspace root for .librarian/project-index.json lookup
recommendation.proposed_action: Implementation fix — no Owner decision required for the fix itself, but fix must be validated by re-running E2E-1
